name: kodezen/storeengine-tests
description: Test harness for the StoreEngine plugin. Lives in its own composer scope so the production build can ship without dev dependencies — the release zip simply excludes the entire tests/ directory and no separate `--no-dev` install step is needed.

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the unit-test suite (no WordPress required). For integration tests, see the project README — they run inside the wp-env Docker container.
